description: Simulated provider /models listings for mock mode. The last snapshot is 'now'; the one before is what the watchdog saw last time (until it has its own record in the data directory). `silent_updates` simulates a provider changing a model behind the same name: in mock mode the model's simulated version (and here its quality) changes, so its canary fingerprint and eval results change.

mock-small.note: Simulates the provider moving the endpoint to a quantized serving build.
